title: TSN egress transmission selection (802.1Qbv gates, 802.1Qav shapers, strict priority, PTP time)

regs.name: CFG
regs.desc: Time increment, schedule and shaper enables

fields.desc: time increment per clock, whole ns (8: 125 MHz)
1 = run the gate control list from GCL_BASE; 0 = all gates open

regs.name: GCL_BASE
regs.desc: Schedule start time, ns: the list starts in the first clock with time >= GCL_BASE

regs.name: CBS_IDLE
regs.desc: Shaper idle slopes, class c in bits 9c+8:9c, in 1/256 of the line rate (0..256)

regs.name: GCL_WR
regs.desc: Writes one gate control list entry; writing GCL_WR commits it. Write entries while CFG.gcl_en = 0

fdesc.gcl_wgates: gate states, bit c = class c open

regs.name: TIME_SET
regs.desc: Loads the time (fraction 0); writing TIME_SET1 commits it

regs.name: TIME_ADJ
regs.desc: Adds a signed offset to the time once; writing TIME_ADJ commits it

regs.name: TIME
regs.desc: Current time, ns. TIME0 and TIME1 are read separately: read TIME1, TIME0, TIME1 again and retry if TIME1 changed

fields.desc: gate state per class (all open while the list does not run)

regs.name: CREDIT
regs.desc: Shaper credits, class c in bits 20c+19:20c, signed, 1/256 byte

irqs.name: CYCLE
irqs.desc: a gate control list cycle started

irqs.name: TX
irqs.desc: a frame was selected for transmission

notes: q_valid / q_len / q_pop connect to the four class queues of the frame buffer (head frame length, pop when taken); tx_start, tx_tc, tx_len, tx_ts and tx_busy connect to the MAC. One byte per PCLK: a frame of L bytes occupies the line for L + 20 clocks.

The wrapper takes tx_start and tx_busy into IRQ_STATUS and STATUS; the MAC uses |q_pop as the frame start strobe (q_pop is one-hot in exactly that clock). tx_ts is the time in the clock the frame was selected (the egress timestamp before the MAC's fixed latency).
